result.instructions: Tools for InPost ShipX, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our shipments were created yesterday, and what is their status?"; "Track parcel 630000328531876219900746 and show me its status history."; "List the dispatch orders we have booked this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes InPost ShipX data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inpost_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inpost_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inpost_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inpost_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inpost_list_organizations
tools.title: List organisations
tools.description: List the ShipX organisations this token can access. Good first call to find the organisation id. ShipX API: GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: inpost_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organisation
tools.description: Get one organisation by id, as ShipX returns it. ShipX API: GET /v1/organizations/{id}.

organization_id.description: Organisation id. Defaults to the id you logged in with.

tools.name: inpost_list_shipments
tools.title: List shipments
tools.description: Search the organisation's shipments by id, creation date range, tracking number, status, service or carrier. Returns a paged collection. Rates are null for debit clients. ShipX API: GET /v1/organizations/{id}/shipments.

organization_id.description: Organisation id. Defaults to the id you logged in with.

created_at.description: Only shipments created on this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_at_gteq.description: Created at or after this time (ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp).

created_at_lteq.description: Created at or before this time (ISO 8601 or Unix timestamp).

tracking_number_cont.description: Tracking number that contains this text.

status.description: Only shipments with these statuses (e.g. confirmed, offers_prepared, delivered) in this list (any match).

service.description: Only shipments with these services (e.g. inpost_locker_standard) in this list (any match).

carrier.description: Only shipments with these carriers (e.g. InPost Paczkomaty) in this list (any match).

tools.name: inpost_track_shipment
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Get the current status, service, locker details and status history (newest first) for a tracking number. Available for 45 days after creation; not on the sandbox. ShipX API: GET /v1/tracking/{tracking_number}.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the shipment.

tools.name: inpost_list_statuses
tools.title: List shipment statuses
tools.description: List the shipment status codes ShipX uses, to read the status values in tracking and shipment results. ShipX API: GET /v1/statuses.

tools.name: inpost_list_dispatch_orders
tools.title: List dispatch orders
tools.description: List the organisation's dispatch orders (courier pickups booked for shipments), paged. ShipX API: GET /v1/organizations/{id}/dispatch_orders.

organization_id.description: Organisation id. Defaults to the id you logged in with.

tools.name: inpost_get_dispatch_order
tools.title: Get a dispatch order
tools.description: Get one dispatch order by id, as ShipX returns it. ShipX API: GET /v1/dispatch_orders/{id}.
